# Jim Pattison Toyota - Downtown

> Jim Pattison Toyota - Downtown is a  dealership in Vancouver. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/jim-pattison-toyota-downtown-mirror/used/): 46 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/jim-pattison-toyota-downtown-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, all vehicles with VIN, price, mileage and availability
